action_items: Pre-existing, out-of-matrix backend tests test_tscheck_extraction.py and test_tscheck_ocr.py fail (KeyError: 'extraction_method') because the API field was renamed to extraction_source; unrelated to this iteration's vendor-ownership matrix, left unmodified.

test_tscheck_split.py::test_split_po_progression is flaky under the mandated -n 2 --dist loadscope xdist config (parallel worker races two calls sharing session state) but passes reliably in serial (-n 0); documented, not a vendor-mismatch regression.

checks.criterion: An explicit PO reference must belong to the invoice vendor
checks.name: test_tscheck_vendor_mismatch.py::test_vendor_po_mismatch_rejected_before_amount_check
checks.evidence: HTTP POST /api/invoices/process (custom Globex PDF, PO Reference: PO-1001) returned 200; decision=reject, reason_code=vendor_po_mismatch, reason='PO-1001 belongs to Acme Corporation, not Globex Industries...', no cumulative_amount set.

checks.criterion: An explicit PO reference must belong to the invoice vendor
checks.name: vendor-mismatch-rejected
checks.evidence: Playwright: uploaded custom Globex PDF citing PO-1001 via invoice-pdf-file-input; decision-label=reject, decision-reason-code contains 'vendor po mismatch', reason text names PO-1001, Acme Corporation, and Globex Industries.

checks.criterion: Happy path remains valid after vendor ownership check
checks.name: live-run-happy-path
checks.evidence: Playwright rerun: sample-invoice-happy-button run completed all pipeline stages; decision-label=approve, reason code contains within tolerance.

checks.criterion: Split-PO flow remains valid after vendor ownership check
checks.name: split-po-completes
checks.evidence: Playwright rerun: Split PO 1 of 2 -> pending/partial; Split PO 2 of 2 -> approve/within tolerance.

checks.criterion: Split-PO flow remains valid after vendor ownership check
checks.name: test_tscheck_split.py::test_split_po_progression
checks.evidence: Serial run (-n 0): sample_key=split-1 -> 200 pending/partial; sample_key=split-2 -> 200 approve/within_tolerance, cumulative_amount 10000.

checks.name: decision-rules-branches
checks.evidence: Playwright rerun: Over tolerance (Northstar Industrial vs PO-1003, $10,200) displayed decision flag/amount_mismatch with visible reason text.

checks.name: test_tscheck_decisions.py::test_decision_order_branches
checks.evidence: HTTP POST /api/invoices/process sample_key=over-tolerance returned 200; response flag/amount_mismatch for Northstar Industrial against PO-1003.

checks.name: test_tscheck_under_ceiling.py::test_northstar_just_under_ceiling_approves
checks.evidence: HTTP POST /api/invoices/process (custom Northstar PDF, $9,900 vs PO-1003 $9,500 +/-5%, ceiling $9,975) returned 200; decision=approve, reason_code=within_tolerance, cumulative_amount=9900.0.

checks.name: northstar-under-ceiling-approves
checks.evidence: Playwright: uploaded custom Northstar $9,900 PDF citing PO-1003; decision-label=approve, decision-reason-code contains within tolerance.

checks.criterion: Vendor mismatch does not affect cumulative PO billing
checks.name: test_tscheck_vendor_mismatch.py::test_vendor_mismatch_excluded_from_po_cumulative
checks.evidence: 3 sequential HTTP POST /api/invoices/process calls (Acme $4,000 -> cumulative 4000; Globex mismatch $50,000 against PO-1001 -> reject/vendor_po_mismatch, no cumulative; Acme $4,200 -> cumulative 8200, approve/within_tolerance), confirming the $50,000 rejected invoice was excluded.
